Load world boundaries

world <- st_read(here("data", "World_Countries_(Generalized).geojson")) %>%
  clean_names()
## Reading layer `World_Countries_(Generalized)' from data source 
##   `/Users/claudiahuang1101/Desktop/CASA0005 GIS&Science/week5_yifeng_map/data/World_Countries_(Generalized).geojson' 
##   using driver `GeoJSON'
## Simple feature collection with 251 features and 5 fields
## Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
## Dimension:     XY
## Bounding box:  xmin: -180 ymin: -89 xmax: 180 ymax: 83.6236
## Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84

Calculate diff in GII (2019 - 2010)

gii_clean <- gii %>%
  dplyr::select(iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019) %>%
  mutate(gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010)

Convert ISO2 codes to ISO3

world_iso3 <- world %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(iso, origin = "iso2c", destination = "iso3c"))

Join GII to world boundaries

world_gii <- world_iso3 %>%
  left_join(gii_clean, by = "iso3")

Check & preview

world_gii %>%
  filter(is.na(gii_diff)) %>%
  pull(country)

qtm(world_gii, fill = "gii_diff")
## [tip] Consider a suitable map projection, e.g. by adding `+ tm_crs("auto")`.
## [`tm_scale_intervals()`] Variable(s) "fill" contains positive and negative
## values, so midpoint is set to 0. Set midpoint = NA to show the full range of
## visual values.
## This message is displayed once per session.

summary(world_gii$gii_diff)
##     Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max.      NAs 
## -0.50100 -0.07000 -0.04900 -0.05589 -0.02900  0.26100       94
gii_clean %>%
  filter(
    nchar(iso3) == 3,
    !is.na(gii_2010),
    !is.na(gii_2019)
  ) %>%
  anti_join(st_drop_geometry(world_iso3), by = "iso3")
## # A tibble: 0 × 4
## # ℹ 4 variables: iso3 <chr>, gii_2010 <dbl>, gii_2019 <dbl>, gii_diff <dbl>
tmap_mode("plot")
## ℹ tmap modes "plot" - "view"
## ℹ toggle with `tmap::ttm()`
gii_map <- tm_shape(world_gii) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "gii_diff",
    col = "grey50",
    lwd = 0.3,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      values = c("#762A83", "#AF8DC3", "#E7D4E8",
           "#D9F0D3", "#7FBF7B", "#1B7837"),
      breaks = c(-0.6, -0.1, -0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.6)
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "GII change\n2019 minus 2010")
  ) +
  tm_title("Change in gender inequality, 2010–2019") +
  tm_credits(
  "Data: UNDP HDR25; boundaries: Esri",
  size = 0.6,
  position = tm_pos_out("center", "bottom")
)

gii_map

png(
  filename = here("gii_change_map.png"),
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  type = "quartz"
)

print(gii_map)
dev.off()
